acceptance_predicates.description: An explicit cli2key provider selection executes a normal ASB Codex benchmark run and produces typed development-live evidence.
A bounded multi-point sweep reuses one supervised sidecar lifetime while binding every attempt and respecting concurrency limits.
Auth expiry, wrong key, 401, 429, drift, crash, timeout, cancellation, and uncertain effects are typed and never cause fallback.
Sidecar queue/transport overhead is separated from agent execution latency and provenance remains explicit.

definition_of_done: Credential-free fake-sidecar run and multi-point sweep pass.
Reports and comparisons retain exact provider/model/runtime provenance.
Independent review and exact-head/post-merge CI pass.

outputs.description: Normal run and sweep support for explicit cli2key selections.

gates.description: A full fake-sidecar run and bounded sweep complete through public CLI surfaces.
Concurrency and all typed provider/sidecar failures remain bounded and fail closed.
